Nguồn: [SceneFileWriter](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.scene.scene_file_writer.SceneFileWriter.html)

# SceneFileWriter

Qualified name: `manim.scene.scene\_file\_writer.SceneFileWriter`

class SceneFileWriter(*settings*)
:   Bases: `object`

    Coordinate segment jobs and assemble one scene’s media artifacts.

    The writer receives immutable resolved settings and concrete top-left-origin
    RGBA arrays. Ownership of each array passed to
    [`write_frame()`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.scene.scene_file_writer.SceneFileWriter.html#manim.scene.scene_file_writer.SceneFileWriter.write_frame "manim.scene.scene_file_writer.SceneFileWriter.write_frame") transfers to the writer; callers must not mutate or reuse
    it afterward. For video output the writer coordinates queued
    `VideoSegmentEncoder` jobs, then assembles their silent cached
    segments with optional audio, sections, and subcaptions. It also writes
    still images and PNG sequences described by the output plan.

    Parameters:
    :   **settings** (*\_SceneFileWriterSettings*) – Resolved output, encoding, pool, cache, and asset-search settings.

    sections
    :   Ordered section metadata for the scene.

    partial\_movie\_files
    :   Segment paths in animation order, including `None` for skipped plays.
